tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every screen, deck and document.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, chat transcripts and anything that sits on the page.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised or inset areas inside a card: code blocks, table headers, hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, table metadata on any surface (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders and mono labels on any surface (4.9:1 or better). Never for sentences.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand blue as text and marks: links, focus rings, active states, key figures. Reads on every surface (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Background of the primary button and selected chips. Pair with on-accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill (5.3:1 dark, 6.7:1 light).

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: The warm off-white accent: the ground of a light section inside a dark page, print stock, the cover's relief block. Text on it is always ink-on-bone.

tokens.name: ink-on-bone
tokens.usage: Text on bone, in either theme. In Expressive mode also the border and hard-shadow colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted-on-bone
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bone: captions and helper lines inside a bone card (about 8.7:1).

tokens.name: line-on-bone
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside a bone card. Decorative only.

tokens.name: accent-on-bone
tokens.usage: Blue text and marks on bone: a pricing headline, a tag. Same value as the light-theme accent.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent-fill buttons. The light value is a proposal: check it before shipping.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover. The light value is a proposal: check it before shipping.

tokens.name: chart-neutral
tokens.usage: The non-accent series in a chart, next to an accent-fill series. A fill, not a boundary: give it a 1px border-control outline, because the fill alone is under 3:1 on its surface.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Expressive mode only: the price block and stickers. Text on it is always ink-on-bone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, connected, healthy. Text or icon on any surface; always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, disconnected, destructive. Text or icon on any surface; always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

shadow.note: Calm mode uses no shadows. These are the hard offset shadows of Expressive mode only.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: Expressive mode: primary buttons and selected chunky options. Pressed: move the element 4px toward the shadow and shrink it to 2px. On a black ground the shadow colour becomes bone or accent-fill.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-md
tokens.usage: Expressive mode: cards.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-lg
tokens.usage: Expressive mode: the hero card and the price block.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements and the wordmark. One per page.

styles.name: display-mega
styles.usage: Expressive mode headlines. One per section. Scale down to 64px on narrow screens (about 11vw in between).

styles.name: display-mega-italic
styles.usage: One phrase inside a display-mega headline, in accent-fill (accent-on-bone on bone). Needs the italic cut of Instrument Serif.

styles.name: display-price
styles.usage: Expressive mode price figure. Scale down to 88px on narrow screens.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings in the UI and in documents.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We design, build and operate WhatsApp agents that answer your customers with your own knowledge.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: We use messages only to run the service, never for advertising.
styles.usage: Long reading: the privacy policy and terms. Colour ink, never ink-muted.

styles.name: heading-legal
styles.usage: Numbered section headings in legal pages.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The figure of a dashboard stat tile. One highlighted in accent per row.

styles.name: stat-sm
styles.usage: The figure of a secondary stat tile.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Un asistente en tu WhatsApp que contesta lo de siempre.
styles.usage: Expressive mode intro paragraph under a display-mega headline.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, metadata. Set in uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps in dense rows: table rows, rail rows, marker-to-label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gaps between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of compact callouts and detail lists.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between content blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between page sections. Be generous: whitespace reads as confidence.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Expressive mode: padding between large sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Expressive mode: padding of the big full-width bands (the hero follow-up, the price band, the closing call to action).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Expressive mode: square corners on cards, buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, dialogs. The largest radius for rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars. In Expressive mode also the round sticker. Never pill-shaped buttons.
